findings.title: T12's relation checker never has its two displayed sides tested where they differ, so a tool that draws the same matrix in both panels beside 'not equal' passes every T12 and M8 test
findings.location: site/src/components/tools/T12RepresentationBuilder.svelte:906-907 ({@render matrix('relation-left', ..., check.left)} / relation-right); site/tests/e2e/T12.spec.ts:132-157 (the D4 node 2 acceptance reads only data-holds and the verdict text), :234-251 (the sides are read only for ef:1,2 and serre-e:1,2 on A2, where both are zero); site/tests/unit/tools/T12.test.ts:1238 (data-format only)
findings.claim: The acceptance 'choosing the non-minuscule node 2 of D4 shows a failing relation' and the bullet 'displays the matrix on each side of the relation' are proven only by the verdict. No test reads the cells of relation-left and relation-right for a relation whose sides differ, so the gate item 'acceptance of T12 as automated tests' passes with the left side removed.
findings.expected: SPEC 4 T12: 'a relation checker: the reader picks one of the Chevalley-Serre relations and one or two nodes, and the tool displays the matrix on each side of the relation and whether they are equal (chevalleySerre)'; acceptance 'choosing the non-minuscule node 2 of D4 shows a failing relation'; 9.2 'its acceptance criteria are automated and pass'; 9.1 G5 'acceptance of T12'; COMMON 4.3 'A test must fail when the behaviour it guards is removed'. On D4 node 2 with q=ef:1,1, relation-left must hold [E1, F1] and relation-right H1, the two records of chevalleySerre, which differ.
findings.observed: With redteam/mutations/t12-relation-left-shows-right.patch (relation-left drawn from check.right, so both panels show H1 next to 'not equal'): T12.test.ts 56 passed, and T12.spec.ts + M8.spec.ts '70 passed (4.0m)'. The reproducer site/tests/e2e/redteam-RT-10-t12-figure.spec.ts > 'on node 2 of D4 the relation checker shows the two different sides of [E1, F1] = H1' fails under the patch ('relation-left is [E1, F1] of chevalleySerre') and passes at 006f50d.
findings.reproduction: From a clean checkout of 006f50d plus branch a6efaed: npm ci --prefer-offline; npm run build; PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=<browsers> npx playwright test -c redteam/playwright.rt10.config.ts redteam-RT-10-t12-figure.spec.ts -g 'two different sides' (passes). Then git apply redteam/mutations/t12-relation-left-shows-right.patch; npx vitest run site/tests/unit/tools/T12.test.ts (56 passed); npm run build; npx playwright test -c redteam/playwright.rt10.config.ts T12.spec.ts M8.spec.ts --workers=1 (70 passed); npx playwright test -c redteam/playwright.rt10.config.ts redteam-RT-10-t12-figure.spec.ts -g 'two different sides' (fails).
findings.specRef: SPEC.md 4 T12 bullet 3 and Acceptance; 9.1 G5 ('acceptance of T12 as automated tests'); 9.2; RED-TEAM-COMMON 4 ('a test suite that passes while the behaviour is absent'); RT-10 attack 1

On the tool route, and after every pick of a board or a node, the start is omega_i (1 at the node, 0 elsewhere) instead of 6.6's default for numbers. The choice is recorded in decisions/P5-A2.md as the tool's own default, without naming 6.6. The reader can still type (1, 1).
